text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Fuji Kiseki, who made headlines with her bold challenge,
is also running in this Takamatsunomiya Kinen!’"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Crowds of spectators are flocking in to see her
in this 1200m blitz battle!"

The stands shown on the screen were packed with fans
holding Fuji Kiseki merch and banners.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, incredible...!
You can feel their expectations coming right through the screen!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has such a wonderful smile.
They must really be looking forward to this.
choice_data_list: Am I putting too much pressure on you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine. I can't put on a show
if I'm shivering over something like this."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I made a promise to everyone. I will definitely
put on a fantastic piece of entertainment for you!"
—With Fuji Kiseki's spirited gesture, a paper cup on the desk was knocked over.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sorry, sorry!
Good thing it was in a paper cup~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oops, gotta wipe this up. Towel, towel!
While feeling a slight sense of unease over a blunder she wouldn't normally make—

The curtain slowly rose on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
her very first challenge of the Senior Year.
